| **The 11th Hour** | 2007 | Leila Conners | A global environmental crisis overview featuring voices from science, business, and faith. |

| **The End of the Line** | 2009 | Mark Brown | Focuses on overfishing and the broader ecological consequences of human activity, including climate impacts. |
